# Gilberto Carrillo

> AI Engineer & Team Lead with 3 years building production LLM platforms, workflow engines and agents in Python, FastAPI and Azure. Based in Venezuela, open to remote AI engineering roles building agentic products and LLM platforms.

I build the backend behind agentic products: the infrastructure that turns "wire an LLM into a feature" into something reliable enough for real clients.

## Experience

### MAIDEPOT — Remote, South Korea-based platform for AI workflows and agents (Jul 2023 – Aug 2026)

**Backend Engineer & Team Lead — AI Platform (Jan 2024 – Aug 2026)**

- Promoted to Team Lead within six months; led a cross-functional engineering team (frontend, full-stack and QA) while remaining the main backend contributor and owning architecture decisions.
- Built a model-agnostic LLM layer across 7 providers (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, LG EXAONE), with retries, rate-limit failover and load balancing, and the multi-model chat on top of it.
- Re-architected the workflow engine into a JSON-defined DAG with parallel execution, LLM-evaluated branches and map-reduce loops; KOTRA and The Korea Times built their own workflows on it.
- Delivered translation of documents up to 1,000 pages and transcription of long audio and video, two of the platform's most-used features.
- Extended the platform to PydanticAI agents with ~40 native tools, workflows as tools and scheduled routines; delivered client agents such as a sales-training assistant for LG and Spanish tutors for Korean language academies.
- Built RAG knowledge bases (pgvector, Cohere rerank) and a vector-free LLM wiki engine.
- Owned the core FastAPI backend: SSE streaming, business-level multi-tenancy, Redis locks and rate limiting.
- Built the public API (hashed API tokens, rate limits per operation), usage-based billing priced per model and token type, the document drive and the enterprise dashboard.
- Managed releases on Azure App Service across dev, staging and production with zero-downtime slot swaps; ran heavy workloads on Azure Functions with Storage Queues.

**Backend Engineer (Jul 2023 – Dec 2023)**

- Migrated the platform's core backend, including its original text and image generation apps, from Google Cloud Functions to a dedicated FastAPI service, eliminating cold starts and consolidating the logic into a single, maintainable API.
